direction: Non-anthropomorphic botanical; all stems plain, no face or human features
user_request: 蘑菇都不要擬人化，整個設計重新調整。

base.prompt: Redesign the attached red mushroom icon to satisfy a strict NON-ANTHROPOMORPHIC natural botanical direction. Remove BOTH eyes, all eye highlights, mouth/smile, both blush cheeks, all facial markings and any suggestion of a face. Replace the egg-shaped mascot body with a NATURAL short gently tapered cylindrical cream mushroom STALK, subtly flaring where it meets the cap; not a head, belly, person, or character. The stalk is completely plain ivory with soft shading. Keep a broad coral-red mushroom dome, FIVE large ivory spots ONLY ON THE CAP, simple gill underside, matte cream-gumdrop 2.5D material, diffuse light from upper left. A tiny low natural tuft of sage leaves sits behind the foot, not paired appendages or arms. Overall a refined modern cute botanical object, not kawaii mascot. No face, eyes, dots on stem, smile, mouth, cheeks, hands, arms, legs, clothing or accessories. Square canvas, isolated object on TRUE transparent background, whole mushroom contained with 15% padding and foot near 85% height. Crisp simple silhouette readable at 32px. No text or scene, no outlines, no sticker border, no background shadow. This is a complete replacement style master.
base.legacy_reference_usage: One-time edit solely to remove face and replace mascot body with natural stalk; not an active visual reference.
